verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own workflow automation, including updating fields when a deal is closed and routing leads (zoho-crm-docs-32). Insert-records docs confirm that record creation triggers workflows (zoho-crm-docs-14), and Zia can generate workflows (zoho-crm-docs-29). However, the pack shows only the record-update action; it never shows workflows creating tasks or sending notifications, and the evidence is thin marketing copy. Missing for 10: documented task-creation and notification/email actions in workflows, details on trigger types and conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
